ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Companies Act 1981 (ss. 14-33, 46, 98); Beneficial Ownership (Companies) Amendment Act 2018 and Beneficial Ownership (Companies) Regulations 2019 (as amended 2022); Proceeds of Crime Act 1997; Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2018; Anti-Terrorism (Financial and Other Measures) Act 2004; Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966. Supervisory and enforcement competence: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA), Bermuda Financial Intelligence Agency, and the Registrar of Companies.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory per the Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2018 (rr. 4-12): (a) identify and verify every shareholder, beneficial owner at or above the 25% threshold, director, and authorized signatory before incorporation; (b) screen all parties against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, UK Sanctions List, EU Consolidated List, and Bermuda's domestic sanctions designations; (c) apply heightened due diligence to any domestic or foreign PEP, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds analysis and senior-management approval for higher-risk relationships; (d) evaluate adverse media and calibrate the business risk rating, treating app-store freemium revenue from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing as a low-risk standard commercial profile subject to normal transaction monitoring; (e) retain CDD and screening records for at least five years after the end of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registry of Companies - Name Search and Reservation facility delivered through the Government of Bermuda Gov.bm E-Services Portal (Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory names must be expressed in English using the Latin alphabet; transliteration from foreign scripts is not permitted in the registered name. An exempted company must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.'. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any name already on the Bermuda register, must not be misleading, and must not imply Crown, government, or regulatory patronage.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bermuda (where it implies governmental or Crown sponsorship)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant, acting through a Bermuda-licensed registered agent, may file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the rejection, stating the legal and factual basis for distinctiveness and attaching trademark search and availability evidence. If the Registrar maintains the refusal, the applicant may either (i) submit an alternative name for fresh clearance, or (ii) appeal to the Minister of Finance where the contested word is in the sensitive category; the final remedy is judicial review before the Supreme Court of Bermuda under the Companies Act 1981 and the Supreme Court Act 1905. A reserved name may be extended once for a further 30-day period upon written application submitted before the initial reservation expires.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a stand-alone arrangement: every Bermuda exempted company must maintain a physical registered office in Bermuda at the premises of a licensed corporate service provider (Companies Act 1981, s. 46). Mail-forwarding and 'virtual office' services are acceptable only when layered on a licensed CSP registered office; the underlying software development and app-store operations are digital and may be managed remotely from any jurisdiction.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low overall. For a non-licensed, low-risk digital software company, the probability of an unannounced on-site inspection at the registered office by the Registrar of Companies or the BMA in any 12-month period is estimated at under 10%. However, the licensed registered agent/CSP itself is subject to BMA compliance inspections on a risk-based cycle (typically every 2-5 years), and full cooperation with any such inspection is mandatory.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 1981 (Bermuda), Part II ss. 4-7 (incorporation by registration) and Part III ss. 129A-133 (exempted companies)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation issued under the Companies Act 1981, supported by the Memorandum of Association and Bye-Laws
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory paid-up capital requirement; the Memorandum of Association must state authorised capital of at least BD$12,000 (US$12,000 equivalent). No escrow account or paid-up deposit is required for an exempted company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company shall be registered with the Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda, as a Bermuda exempted company under the Companies Act 1981, and that the Memorandum of Association and Bye-Laws submitted with the incorporation application are hereby approved and adopted as the governing instruments. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office at the approved address in Hamilton, Bermuda be and is hereby fixed as the statutory registered office for service of process. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the subscribers shall take up, and the directors shall allot, the initial shares forming an authorised capital of not less than US$12,000 as set out in the Memorandum, to be issued as fully paid or credited as fully paid. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] and [Name] are appointed as the first directors, and [Name] as secretary, each to serve until the first annual general meeting, with authority to execute all filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (via a licensed Bermuda law firm or incorporated agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit via a Bermuda-resident authorized agent an application to reserve the exact exempted company name, ending with 'Limited' or 'Ltd', together with a brief description of the proposed mobile software and app-store payment activities. The agent checks the register for conflict and obtains a name clearance. Notarization is not required at this stage, but the agent must hold the authorization letter from the proposed beneficial owner.
required_dossiers: Authorized corporate resolution or beneficial owner consent
Proof of identity and address of the subscriber/shareholder
Corporate overview and intended activities description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity, submit a fresh name reservation or request reconsideration with supporting trademark and prior-use evidence; an appeal to the Supreme Court of Bermuda is available.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitution and Corporate Actions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda licensed legal counsel / incorporated agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association and Bye-Laws containing the permitted objects, share structure, and authorised capital of at least US$12,000. Have the subscribers execute before a notary public; obtain consents to act from the first directors, secretary, and registered office provider. Ensure all documents are in English and comply with the Companies Act 1981.
required_dossiers: Consents to Act as Director and Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct and re-execute the defective documents; if notarization is deficient, obtain a fresh notarial certificate. No government filing occurs until the document package is complete and internally consistent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (online filing portal or Registrar's office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the completed and signed package through the authorized agent via the Registrar's e-filing system or in person at the Registrar's office. Attach the name clearance letter, Declaration of Compliance, and Memorandum/Bye-Laws. Pay the official state fee of US$1,775 (or BMD equivalent) and obtain a receipt. The Registrar will issue an acknowledgement or a requisition if further information is required.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized Memorandum and Bye-Laws
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any Registrar's requisition by filing corrective pages and re-submitting within 14 business days. If the requisition is satisfied, the application proceeds as originally filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue of Certificate of Incorporation and Exempted Status
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar registers the company, issues the Certificate of Incorporation, and records the exempted company status. Obtain certified true copies of the Certificate and registered constitutional documents. Verify that the company name, registered office, capital, and exempted status are correctly stated.
required_dossiers: Certified true copies of Memorandum and Bye-Laws
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File a Request for Correction with the Registrar if the certificate contains typographical or substantive errors; alternatively, apply to the Supreme Court for rectification of the register.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of Registered Office and Issuance of Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office provider / board of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered office provider confirms the Hamilton, Bermuda address and the directors execute a board resolution allotting the initial shares. Share certificates are issued and entered in the register of members. The Registrar is notified of the registered office address, director details, and secretary details in accordance with the Companies Act 1981.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the statutory notice of director or registered office changes is rejected, correct and resubmit the notice with the required supporting consent and pay any applicable late filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Tax Commissioner / Bermuda Revenue Agency; Financial Intelligence Agency (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For a software and mobile utility app company operating via Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, no separate statutory software licence is required. However, if employees are engaged, register as an employer for Bermuda payroll tax. If carrying on local business from premises, apply for a general Business Licence under the Business Licence Act 2014. Prepare any relevant Economic Substance notification to establish that the business is not a relevant activity, to the extent the app licence revenues are passive in nature.
required_dossiers: Employer payroll tax registration form (if hiring)
Business Licence application (if carrying on local business)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File a corrective payroll tax registration or Business Licence application without delay; any late penalty may be mitigated by making a voluntary disclosure to the Tax Commissioner or Business Licence Unit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licence Unit, Department of Revenue, Government of Bermuda (general business licensing); Department of Environment and Natural Resources for any physical premises; no dedicated industrial licensing authority is applicable to ISIC 6201 software development
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business Licence under the Business Licence Act 2014, where local business activity occurs; no sectoral industry operating permit is required for mobile application software publishing

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources, Ministry of Home Affairs, Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not applicable / Exempt - the activity is purely software-based and does not involve land disturbance, industrial manufacturing, or emission generating installations; no formal EIA report or registration is required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC discharge thresholds apply. Any office-generated waste must be removed by an approved waste carrier; no atmospheric emissions exceed regulatory de minimis levels.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate and occupancy approval from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service are required for any leased office premises; structural load inspection is the responsibility of the landlord and building owner. Under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 1982, workplace safety clearance and employee welfare compliance are required once personnel are engaged.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Government of Bermuda, Ministry of Finance: Office of the Tax Commissioner (payroll tax, corporate income tax administration) and Bermuda Customs Department (customs duties); entity registration by the Registrar of Companies. Official Government portal: https://www.gov.bm.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Bermuda exempted company is formed under the Companies Act 1981 through the Registrar of Companies; the Certificate of Incorporation carries the company registration number, which serves as the Bermuda corporate identifier. Bermuda does not maintain a general income tax TIN or VAT ID. No VAT/GST registration is required. If the company has Bermuda-resident employees, it must separately register with the Office of the Tax Commissioner for payroll tax and with the Bermuda social insurance system; if it belongs to an in-scope multinational group with consolidated revenue at or above EUR 750m, registration under the Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 is required. Non-resident ownership is permitted, and no minimum capital filing is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists in Bermuda. A company elects exempted status at incorporation under the Companies Act 1981 and may apply for a Tax Protection Certificate under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966. The certificate shelters qualifying exempted companies from future Bermuda taxes on income, profits, capital gains and distributions until 31 March 2035. Exchange-control non-resident designation is also available. The Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 applies separately to large multinational groups notwithstanding general tax exemption.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Bermuda imposes no VAT, GST or sales-and-use tax; indirect levies are customs duties, stamp duties and similar transaction duties. UK VAT at 20% may apply separately where digital services are supplied to UK consumers through app-store distribution.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable – no Bermuda VAT/GST registration threshold exists. For UK VAT, a non-established overseas supplier making taxable digital supplies to UK consumers must register with HMRC from the first supply with no monetary threshold; the marketplace or deemed-supplier analysis should be reviewed for Apple IAP and Google Play Billing distribution.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Bermuda has no electronic-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping mandate. The UK does not require real-time e-invoice clearance for app-store sales; VAT returns and relevant records must be maintained under Making Tax Digital using HMRC-compatible software and APIs, and no per-transaction fiscal stamping applies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable under Bermuda law: no Bermuda VAT/GST exists, so there is no 0% export VAT rate or refundable export-credit mechanism in Bermuda. Digital app exports and offshore services are outside Bermuda's indirect tax net. If UK VAT is separately engaged, genuine exports of goods from the UK may be zero-rated with proper evidence, and B2B digital services may be outside UK VAT scope when the customer belongs outside the UK; B2C digital services to UK consumers are standard-rated unless a specific exception applies.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: No Bermuda statutory documentation bundle for export zero-rating because no Bermuda VAT refund regime exists
If a UK zero-rated export of goods were relevant: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading or Airway Bill, commercial invoice and export proof
Where cross-border payment substantiation is required: bank statement or inward remittance confirmation evidencing foreign currency consideration received
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Bermuda has no VAT-export clawback because no VAT refund is obtainable. False customs declarations and evasion of customs duty may attract forfeiture, penalties and prosecution under Bermuda customs law. For any separate UK VAT exposure, HMRC may raise assessments, interest and penalties under the Value Added Tax Act 1994, including penalties for dishonest conduct; retrospective clawback of wrongly zero-rated export VAT can be assessed for up to 4 years, extended for deliberate errors.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermudian Dollar (BMD) is pegged at 1:1 to the US Dollar and is fully convertible. Both current and capital account transactions are unrestricted. Profit remittances, dividends, and liquidation proceeds may be freely transferred abroad subject only to standard AML/ATF screening and beneficial ownership verification. No exchange control approval is required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Bermuda imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender requirement and no mandatory conversion ratio. Export receipts and inbound commercial payments retained in BMD, USD, or other major currencies may be held in corporate bank accounts without repatriation obligation to the BMA.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Limited. Bermuda-licensed fintech and electronic money institutions may provide payment services, but those with a BMA restricted licence do not qualify as full commercial banks and cannot clear Apple IAP or Google Play Billing proceeds directly to an operational account. Offshore digital EMIs are not a substitute for a domestic bank account; they are rated as a supplementary collection vehicle only, and only if licensed within the UK or EEA with a valid passported licence.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person presence is generally required for at least one director or the authorised signatory. Some tier-1 banks permit remote opening via secure video call with independent notarised identification and certified corporate documents; however, a physical interview is the standard for Bermuda exempted companies with non-resident boards. Directors must be prepared to attend a Bermuda office or a designated embassy/branch for identity verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore holding company avoiding economic substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bermuda Economic Substance Act declaration, board minutes evidencing core income-generating activity in Bermuda, payroll and premises records, and a letter from Bermuda registered agent confirming substance compliance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO chain with intermediate shell entities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full organisational chart, certificate of incorporation, register of members, proof of ultimate beneficial owner tax residency, audited financial statements, and a source-of-wealth narrative from the principal shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: App store revenue flow with no physical sales presence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apple/Google developer agreements, app store payout statements, revenue waterfall model, IP ownership/licensing contracts, and a detailed commercial description linking the Bermuda entity to the mobile utility application.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclean criminal or sanctions indicators attached to signatory
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Police clearance certificate from country of residence, resident tax identification number, negative sanctions screening report, and an independent bank reference.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Primary route: SWIFT transfer from the UK parent to the Bermuda entity's operational account, using purpose code 71 'Investment income for distribution' for capital contributions or purpose code 'Capital injection' as agreed by the receiving bank. The remitter must supply a board resolution authorising the capitalisation, proof of source of funds, and a certified copy of the Bermuda exempted company's constitutional documents. Verification by the receiving bank includes UBO screening and confirmation of BMA acceptance (where applicable). Funds should be settled in BMD or USD to avoid conversion friction.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements are cleared via SWIFT MT103 priority payments or discretionary commercial letters of credit (LC) for software licensing and production related payments. The Bermuda entity may instruct payment in GBP, USD, EUR, or BMD without exchange control restriction. Each disbursement requires invoice matching, commercial contract reference, and standard PEP/sanctions screening. For recurring app store payouts, bulk clearing files are accepted by tier-1 banks if formatted as ISO 20022 or bank-specific template.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: BMD/USD is pegged at 1:1 so direct FX risk is minimal; when translating GBP-denominated UK parent cash flows, outright forward contracts with BMA-licensed banks are permitted.
Cross-currency swaps pairing BMD/USD against GBP floating or fixed legs are permissible for tenors under 12 months and are offered to qualifying exempted companies.
Vanilla FX options are allowed for hedging operational revenue volatility (e.g., app store payouts in EUR/USD converted to BMD)

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not required because BMD is fully deliverable and no offshore conversion premium exists; they are only available for exotic pairs and are not a compliance-relevant instrument.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Exempted Company Annual Return (Form 9/Section 115 Companies Act 1981)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of BMD 100; continued default may result in administrative strike-off after notice and 90-day cure period.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Registrar of Companies / Accountant General
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of incorporation (or as invoiced by Registrar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge if unpaid after anniversary; failure to pay for 6 months triggers strike-off proceedings under Section 117A.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies (Bermuda Beneficial Ownership Secure Platform)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, within 30 days of the anniversary of incorporation (or upon any BO change)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: BMD 10,000 fine for non-compliance; directors/offices may be disqualified and company subject to strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All exempted companies must appoint a licensed auditor unless exempted by unanimous shareholder resolution; exemption available only to non-public, non-financial companies.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or US GAAP (no Bermuda-specific mandatory GAAP; financial statements may be prepared under either framework).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Maintain a beneficial ownership register and file annual confirmation via the Registrar's secure BO platform; any share transfer or BO change must be updated within 30 days of becoming known, with annual re-confirmation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders and Directors
Register of Options and Share Warrants (if applicable)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 2,000 - 4,500 (standard registered office and corporate secretarial service)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - 12,000 (subject to transaction volume and group consolidation)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% classic Bermuda corporate income tax: an exempted company pays no tax on profit, capital gains, or distributions. From fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2025, a 15% Corporate Income Tax (CIT Act 2023) applies only to Bermuda constituent entities of in-scope MNE groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million in at least two of the preceding four fiscal years. A typical small mobile utility app developer operating solely through a Bermuda exempted company remains at a 0% effective rate.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax assurance for exempted companies (Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966) freezes future income, capital, and dividend taxes until 2035 (or 2050/30-year premium extensions for qualifying groups); the EUR 750 million threshold is a de facto exemption for app developers; OECD-qualified refundable tax credits offset any top-up tax; substance-based income exclusion (SBIE) reduces the 15% CIT base; no VAT, GST, sales tax, or capital gains tax. The only material levy is Bermuda payroll tax on employers (progressive bands up to approximately 13.5% on annual emoluments above BD$1.5 million).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Compliance Form 1 - Annual Return (Form AR) under the Companies Act 1981, filed on the Bermuda Registrar of Companies e-Registry portal (annual government fee assessed on authorized share capital)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 60 days after the annual general meeting; where no AGM is held, within 30 days after the statutory AGM date and in all cases no later than six months after fiscal year-end

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempted company legal name, exemption number, and date of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exactly the name and number shown on the Certificate of Exemption; no separate non-resident section exists

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Registered office and corporate secretary
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda registered office address and the name of the resident corporate secretary
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Bermuda-licensed registered office and a resident secretary are mandatory; foreign directors' details must be listed in the attached director register

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital cap, issued shares, and nominal value per class
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report in the currency of denomination; no minimum paid-in capital is required, but the annual fee tier is calculated on the authorized capital ceiling

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - AGM and annual return date
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Date of the annual general meeting or the election to dispense with an AGM
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A wholly foreign-owned entity may align its financial year and deemed AGM date with the parent's fiscal calendar

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Officer declaration that the company has not transacted business in breach of the Companies Act
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be signed by a Bermuda-resident director or the resident secretary; no income, revenue, or profit field exists in the classic exemption regime

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a Registrar default notice, automatic BD$1,000 penalty, monthly interest on the unpaid annual fee, and possible Court-ordered strike-off; directors can be summonsed personally where the company is dissolved while indebted.
